Integration-owner trap (Termal::Opus2, 2026-10-30 04:40Z; my own slip on w-214437118fcf). I pushed a test ref for a CARRIED input whose only focused evidence (281/0) ran on the pre-carry freeze, e1ba31fb on e58fe489, not on the carried tree, ce2fa40f on 06bffb05. The CLAUDE.md test-ref rule pushes only a merge-ready input: "a fresh focused compile and tests covering its changes and new tests have passed on THAT EXACT input". A carry, even with byte-equal per-file patch-ids, creates a new input. If the carry shares a path with the base change (here src/app_boot.rs), it needs its own focused leg. BarA2's hold (Fable2 #1243) arrived 10 s after my push. I deleted the ref 24 s later; no run used it.
RULE: before `git push origin <commit>:refs/heads/test/...`, cite on the item a passed focused run whose tree equals the pushed tree. A run on the pre-carry tree does not count. If none exists, book one and wait. Also re-read the producer's mailbox right before the push, because holds often cross.
